features.title: TMDB credits lookup at build time
criteria: films matched to TMDB ids where found
tmdb-overrides.json and credits-manual.json merged; ambiguous match stays unmatched (D-19, D-25)
share of films with an answer printed
features.verify: node scripts/tmdb.ts --dry-run; grep -r TMDB out/ || echo clean
features.evidence: 11 Nov 2026: first real run with Chime's key. `node scripts/tmdb.ts` matched 14 of 31 films; each match was checked by eye against TMDB's title and 2026 release date, and all 14 are right. The 17 unmatched are Nollywood titles TMDB does not list, or titles with more than one current film (Verity), which stay 'not known yet'. Keywords read: Spider-Man: Brand New Day has 179430 (after), Street Fighter has 179431 (during); '2 of 31 films have a credits answer (6%)'. `refresh` puts the ids, runtimes and answers on the films. The key is in no file under out/, data/, public/, scripts/, src/, tests/ or docs/ (grep for its value); the only 'TMDB' in out/ is the source name in the data files. `npm test -- scripts/credits scripts/tmdb` 29 pass. tmdb-overrides.json and credits-manual.json are merged (both still empty).
